questions.learningObjective: evaluate touch targets in a design critique
questions.stem: On Touch targets: a designer reviewing a museum exhibition poster notices that two tiny adjacent links are frequently tapped by mistake. What is the most effective fix for this issue?

options.text: Enlarge the targets and add clear spacing between them
Reduce the spacing further to make the layout more compact
options.misconception: worsens the very accidental taps being complained about

options.text: Make them smaller but considerably brighter in color
options.misconception: confuses visibility with the physical hit area

options.text: Remove the labels and keep only the small icons
